equity.level_reason: Race/ethnicity appears only as a descriptive distribution of hospitalized patients in the Table; no outcome is reported by race and nothing is framed as a disparity. Age defines the population and age-group comparisons lack social-position framing.

level_alternative.reason: Race/ethnicity is only a Table row count; if a bare descriptor is not counted, only age (population, strata) remains, which is level 0.

equity.equity_measurement: Race/ethnicity is a Table descriptor only; NH ethnicity assumed when unknown, AI/AN and multiracial collapsed into 'All other races', cells <10 suppressed. LTCF residence is described but not framed as social position.
